goal: Retain finished private broadcast transactions in memory instead of immediately removing them
Let node operators querying getprivatebroadcastinfo distinguish successful broadcasts from unqueued ones
agreement: Disputed concept due to an open blocking objection (instagibbs)
Concept NACK: adds complexity and memory retention for a narrow set of users (instagibbs)
Support because retained stats help diagnose broadcast outcomes (vasild, optout21)
Unaddressed objection: eviction condition uses if instead of while, possibly exceeding queue limit (optout21)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it improves observability for private broadcast callers but is reasonably deferrable
Resolves status ambiguity for operators checking if a private transaction succeeded
